summary: The following analysis is based on draft bill text that was made available by the House of Representatives and may differ from the bill text as introduced. Nuclear REFUEL (Recycling Efficient Fuels Utilizing Expedited Licensing) Act This bill directs the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to license future recycling facilities that reprocess certain spent nuclear fuel (i.e., radioactive waste) under  regulations for special nuclear material rather than regulations for production and utilization facilities. The bill applies to domestic facilities that reprocess spent nuclear fuel in a manner that does not isolate plutonium. Generally, such recycling facilities reprocess spent nuclear fuel into materials that may be reused as nuclear fuel for electricity.
